title: gufe-viz payload
description: The Python-to-TypeScript contract for gufe visualizations. Nothing generates this file, and both languages are downstream of it. A payload is its 'type' plus its own fields, flat, and it is the same object whether it stands alone or is nested inside another. The version lives in $id, not in the payload.

SmallMoleculeComponentViz.title: SmallMoleculeComponentViz
SmallMoleculeComponentViz.description: A small molecule, carried as a complete SDF record. The SDF holds the conformer, so nothing downstream reconstructs coordinates.

sdf.description: Complete inline SDF record, including the conformer.

total_charge.description: Net formal charge. Displayed, never recomputed from the SDF.

ProteinComponentViz.title: ProteinComponentViz
ProteinComponentViz.description: A protein, carried as a complete PDB record.

SolvatedPDBComponentViz.title: SolvatedPDBComponentViz
SolvatedPDBComponentViz.description: A protein with explicit solvent. A distinct type rather than a flag on ProteinComponentViz, because the discriminator is what a view dispatches on and the presence of waters changes what a sensible default representation is.

pdb.description: Complete inline PDB representation, including explicit solvent.

ProteinMembraneComponentViz.title: ProteinMembraneComponentViz
ProteinMembraneComponentViz.description: A protein embedded in a membrane.

pdb.description: Complete inline PDB representation of the protein and membrane system.

SolventComponentViz.title: SolventComponentViz
SolventComponentViz.description: Bulk solvent settings. There is no structure to draw, so these are flat fields suitable for rendering as a settings card.

ion_concentration.description: Display-form concentration with units, for example '0.15 molar'. A string rather than a number because the unit is part of the value and the view only ever prints it.

UnknownComponentViz.title: UnknownComponentViz
UnknownComponentViz.description: The graceful fallback for a component type this build does not recognize. gufe supports custom Component subclasses, so meeting one is an expected outcome rather than an error, and the browser answers it with 'sorry, there is no visualization for this'. This covers an unrecognized type only: a recognized component whose serializer fails is a bug, and raises in Python rather than arriving here wearing a disguise.

gufe_type.description: The gufe class name, so the panel can say which type it could not draw.

ChemicalSystemViz.title: ChemicalSystemViz
ChemicalSystemViz.description: Visualization-only representation of a GUFE 1.12 ChemicalSystem.

components.description: ChemicalSystem labels mapped to component payloads.

AtomMapping.title: AtomMapping
AtomMapping.description: Atom index correspondence from molecule A to molecule B. Keys are A's atom indices as decimal strings, because JSON object keys are always strings; values are B's indices as integers.

Annotations.title: Annotations
Annotations.description: Free-form mapping metadata. gufe puts nothing here by design and every mapper picks its own keys, so this is deliberately open. Values are whatever survived being made JSON-safe. Displayed but never interpreted, with the single exception of 'score'.

LigandAtomMappingViz.title: LigandAtomMappingViz
LigandAtomMappingViz.description: One atom mapping between two small molecules, standalone. The same object is what the ligand-network view hands to the embedded mapping viewer when an edge is clicked, so there is one mapping shape rather than a standalone one and an in-graph one.

LigandNetworkNodeViz.title: LigandNetworkNodeViz
LigandNetworkNodeViz.description: One ligand in a network. Molecules live here rather than inlined per edge, because a forty-ligand network would otherwise carry each SDF several times over.

id.description: The gufe key. An identity, not a label: gufe's own network fixtures have unnamed molecules, so the view falls back to a short form of this when name is empty.

LigandNetworkEdgeViz.title: LigandNetworkEdgeViz
LigandNetworkEdgeViz.description: One mapping in a network, as topology only. Not a standalone payload: source and target name nodes in the same LigandNetworkViz, and the view reassembles a LigandAtomMappingViz from an edge plus its two endpoint nodes. JSON Schema cannot express that referential constraint, so a Python test covers it, and the view drops a dangling edge with a banner rather than failing.

score.description: The 'score' annotation when it is a plain number, otherwise null. This is the one annotation key that is interpreted rather than displayed: it drives the edge colouring.

LigandNetworkViz.title: LigandNetworkViz
LigandNetworkViz.description: A ligand network as ligands plus topology. Deliberately not gufe's GraphML: that format embeds a gufe to_json moldict per node, so forwarding it would relocate the decoding problem into the browser rather than avoid it.

TransformationViz.title: TransformationViz
TransformationViz.description: A transformation between two chemical systems. NonTransformation uses this type too: it exposes the same stateA and stateB properties, both its single system, so it renders as a diff with no differences.

protocol.description: The protocol class name. Named only, never inspected.

ComponentSummaryViz.title: ComponentSummaryViz
ComponentSummaryViz.description: A component named but not drawn. This is deliberately not a ComponentViz and must not be mistaken for one: it carries no structure at all, because an alchemical network that inlined every system's SDF and PDB would be enormous, and this view shows composition and topology rather than chemistry.

AlchemicalNetworkNodeViz.title: AlchemicalNetworkNodeViz
AlchemicalNetworkNodeViz.description: One ChemicalSystem in an alchemical network, summarized.

id.description: The ChemicalSystem's gufe key. Edges reference it.

AlchemicalNetworkEdgeViz.title: AlchemicalNetworkEdgeViz
AlchemicalNetworkEdgeViz.description: One Transformation in an alchemical network.

AlchemicalNetworkViz.title: AlchemicalNetworkViz
AlchemicalNetworkViz.description: A graph of chemical systems joined by transformations.
